origin.author: jmeter-rs project
origin.description: Hand-authored local HTTP/HTTPS origin routes and bounded loopback proxy contract for outbound proxy, recorder, mirror, CONNECT, and TLS cases.

license.repository_notice: LICENSE and NOTICE at repository root
license.upstream_distribution_use: Apache JMeter 5.6.3 is an external oracle only; no upstream plan, result, binary, certificate, key, or plugin is redistributed.

runtime.jmeter_classpath: profile-pinned Apache JMeter 5.6.3 distribution (SHA-512 checked; PGP verification required before oracle use)
runtime.tls_toolchain: record JDK/keytool and provider versions at external run time
runtime.active_handler_policy: worker-admitted TLS handshake, one absolute monotonic session deadline, bounded join before trace close

inputs.server_policy: stdlib-only, loopback-only, bounded request/response/relay/trace I/O, worker-admitted TLS handshake, one absolute monotonic session deadline, no PID-based lifecycle authority
inputs.runtime_material_policy: Generated local certificates, client keys, JKS stores, and trace/JTL/log output are temporary ignored artifacts and are never committed.
inputs.proxy_secret_policy: The fixture-server has no password command-line option; use an effective-user-owned mode 0600 file below the run root or an explicitly named environment capability. JMeter JVM TLS password assignments use a protected capability and are redacted from persisted argv.
